key_sentences: The success criterion requiring quantitative data in human tumour tissue or serum linked to ICI outcomes remains unfulfilled.", "remaining_gap_recovered_by_policy": false, "status": "unmet", "useful_material": ["This study demonstrates that effector T cells can utilize inosine as an alternative carbon source to support proliferation and function in the absence of glucose in vitro, mediated by purine nucleoside phosphorylase (PNP).", "The authors report that inosine supplementation enhances the anti-tumor efficacy of immune-checkpoint blockade (anti-PD-L1/PD-1) and adoptive T cell transfer in mouse solid tumor models (e.g., B16-F10, LAN-1), particularly when tumor cells are defective in metabolizing inosine.", "The discussion section notes that while inosine and adenosine concentrations in blood plasma are typically in the low micromolar range, they can accumulate to hundreds of micromolar in necrotic, hypoxic, or inflammatory microenvironments (citing references 53, 54), providing a theoretical basis for physiological relevance.", "The study identifies tumor cell metabolic heterogeneity (capacity to utilize inosine) as a critical condition determining whether inosine supplementation benefits immunotherapy, suggesting a potential biomarker for patient stratification."]}
